input.code:
require 'json'

# ============================================================
# Fun-1.1 | Account Product Sync — Step 1: Transform
# ============================================================
# Converts BRD pricing payload → records for SFDC Account_Product__c.
#
# Tier data is now stored as TEXT on the parent record itself:
#   - Pricing_Type__c: "Product Price" | "Tiered Slides" | "Tiered Steps"
#   - Tiers__c: multi-line human-readable tier description
#   - Cost__c: 0 when tiered, real price when flat
#
# Produces:
#   - records: ALL records (flat + ip_tier + tier headers) ready to upsert
#   - skipped: metrics not processed (debugging)
# ============================================================

customer_id  = input["customer_id"]
brd_products = input["brd_products"]

# Pricing may arrive as string or object — handle both
pricing_raw = input["pricing"]
pricing = pricing_raw.is_a?(String) ? JSON.parse(pricing_raw) : pricing_raw
products = pricing["products"] || {}

# ============================================================
# PRE-INDEX LOOKUPS (O(1) match)
# ============================================================
lookup_by_code = {}
lookup_by_brd_metric = {}

brd_products.each do |row|
  lookup_by_code[row["product_code"]] = row
  key = "#{row["brd_product_id"]}__#{row["measurement_metric"]}"
  lookup_by_brd_metric[key] = row
end

# ============================================================
# MAPPINGS
# ============================================================
PRODUCT_PREFIX = {
  "dc"           => "data_center",
  "res_rotating" => "residential",
  "res_static"   => "isp"
}

# IP-tier metrics → how to build per-tier product code
TIER_DEFINITIONS = {
  "unl_bw_shared_tiers" => {
    container: "ip_tiers",
    code_suffix: "unlimited_shared",
    qty_unit: "ip"
  },
  "unl_bw_ded_tiers" => {
    container: "ip_tiers",
    code_suffix: "unlimited_dedicated",
    qty_unit: "ip"
  }
}

# Map raw usg_tiers type → Pricing_Type__c picklist value
USG_TIER_TYPE_MAP = {
  "slide" => "Tiered Slides",
  "steps" => "Tiered Steps"
}

# ============================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================

# Build a flat / ip_tier record
def build_flat_record(customer_id, row, bill_active, price)
  {
    "External_Account_Product_ID" => "#{customer_id}_#{row["product_id"]}",
    "Product"        => row["product_id"],
    "Product_Name"   => row["product"],
    "Unit"           => row["unit"],
    "Bill_Product"   => bill_active ? "Active" : "Inactive",
    "Include_Tiers"  => false,
    "Price"          => price,
    "Pricing_Type"   => "Product Price",
    "Tiers"          => ""
  }
end

# Build a tiered record (with formatted Tiers text)
def build_tier_record(customer_id, row, bill_active, pricing_type, tiers_text)
  {
    "External_Account_Product_ID" => "#{customer_id}_#{row["product_id"]}",
    "Product"        => row["product_id"],
    "Product_Name"   => row["product"],
    "Unit"           => row["unit"],
    "Bill_Product"   => bill_active ? "Active" : "Inactive",
    "Include_Tiers"  => true,
    "Price"          => 0,            # 0, not nil — per PM spec
    "Pricing_Type"   => pricing_type,
    "Tiers"          => tiers_text
  }
end

# Build the multi-line tier text:
#   "0-10000 GB: $2.1/GB
#    10000-15000 GB: $1.9/GB
#    80000+ GB: $1/GB"
def build_tiers_text(tiers, unit)
  lines = []
  previous_qty = 0

  tiers.each do |tier|
    next unless tier.is_a?(Hash)
    next if tier["price"].nil?

    current_qty = tier["qty"]
    price       = tier["price"]

    line = if current_qty.nil?
      # Catch-all last tier
      "#{previous_qty}+ #{unit}: $#{price}/#{unit}"
    else
      "#{previous_qty}-#{current_qty} #{unit}: $#{price}/#{unit}"
    end

    lines << line
    previous_qty = current_qty if current_qty
  end

  lines.join("\n")
end

# ============================================================
# PROCESS
# ============================================================
records = []
skipped = []

products.each do |brd_id, prod|
  next unless prod.is_a?(Hash) && prod["prices"].is_a?(Hash)

  prod["prices"].each do |metric, data|
    next unless data.is_a?(Hash)

    tier_def = TIER_DEFINITIONS[metric]

    # ---------- CASE 1: IP TIERS (each tier qty = own SF record, flat-priced) ----------
    if tier_def && data[tier_def[:container]].is_a?(Array)
      prefix = PRODUCT_PREFIX[brd_id]
      unless prefix
        skipped << "TIER SKIP: #{brd_id}/#{metric} (no product prefix)"
        next
      end

      data[tier_def[:container]].each do |tier|
        next unless tier.is_a?(Hash)

        code = "#{prefix}_#{tier_def[:code_suffix]}_#{tier["qty"]}#{tier_def[:qty_unit]}"
        row = lookup_by_code[code]
        unless row
          skipped << "TIER NOT FOUND: #{code}"
          next
        end

        records << build_flat_record(
          customer_id, row,
          tier["not_bill"] != true,
          tier["price"]
        )
      end

    # ---------- CASE 2: USG TIERS (Tiered Slides / Tiered Steps) ----------
    elsif data["usg_tiers"].is_a?(Hash) && data["usg_tiers"]["tiers"].is_a?(Array)
      row = lookup_by_brd_metric["#{brd_id}__#{metric}"]
      unless row
        skipped << "NOT IN LOOKUP: #{brd_id}/#{metric}"
        next
      end

      usg_tiers    = data["usg_tiers"]
      raw_type     = usg_tiers["type"] || "slide"
      pricing_type = USG_TIER_TYPE_MAP[raw_type] || "Tiered #{raw_type.capitalize}"
      tiers_text   = build_tiers_text(usg_tiers["tiers"], row["unit"])

      if tiers_text.empty?
        skipped << "EMPTY TIERS: #{brd_id}/#{metric}"
        next
      end

      records << build_tier_record(
        customer_id, row,
        data["not_bill"] != true,
        pricing_type,
        tiers_text
      )

    # ---------- CASE 3: FLAT (num_value only) ----------
    else
      row = lookup_by_brd_metric["#{brd_id}__#{metric}"]
      unless row
        skipped << "NOT IN LOOKUP: #{brd_id}/#{metric}"
        next
      end

      if data["num_value"].nil?
        if data["str_value"]
          skipped << "NON-NUMERIC: #{brd_id}/#{metric} (str_value=#{data["str_value"]})"
        elsif data["not_bill"] == true
          skipped << "NOT BILLED: #{brd_id}/#{metric}"
        else
          skipped << "NO PRICE: #{brd_id}/#{metric}"
        end
        next
      end

      records << build_flat_record(
        customer_id, row,
        data["not_bill"] != true,
        data["num_value"]
      )
    end
  end
end

# ============================================================
# COUNT TIERED PRODUCTS (for function-level visibility)
# ============================================================
tiered_count = records.count { |r| r["Include_Tiers"] == true }
has_tiers    = tiered_count > 0

# ============================================================
# RETURN
# ============================================================
{
  "records"               => records,
  "records_count"         => records.size,
  "tiered_products_count" => tiered_count,
  "has_tiers"             => has_tiers,
  "skipped"               => skipped,
  "skipped_count"         => skipped.size
}

# ============================================================
# Fun-1.1 | Account Product Sync — Step 3
# Compare and filter changed account products
# ============================================================
# Matches new records (Step 1) vs existing SFDC records (Step 2).
# Classifies as: New / Changed / Unchanged / Skipped / Orphan.
# Outputs:
#   - 4 internal lists (for SF actions inside Fun-1.1)
#   - all_records (lowercase, flat) → exposed to caller
# ============================================================

new_records = input["new_records"]
sfdc_data   = input["sfdc_records"]
account_id  = input["account_id"]
lead_id     = input["lead_id"]
customer_id = input["customer_id"] || ""

# ============================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================
def normalize_num(v)
  return nil if v.nil? || v.to_s.strip == ""
  Float(v) rescue nil
end

def normalize_bool(v)
  return true  if v == true  || v.to_s.downcase == "true"
  false
end

def normalize_text(v)
  return "" if v.nil?
  v.to_s
end

def parse_sfdc_list(raw)
  return [] if raw.nil?
  return raw if raw.is_a?(Array)
  return raw["records"]            if raw.is_a?(Hash) && raw["records"].is_a?(Array)
  return raw["Account_Product__c"] if raw.is_a?(Hash) && raw["Account_Product__c"]
  []
end

def resolve_parent(account_id, lead_id, sfdc_list)
  has_account = !(account_id.nil? || account_id == "")
  has_lead    = !(lead_id.nil?    || lead_id    == "")

  if !has_account && !has_lead && !sfdc_list.empty?
    sfdc_list.each do |rec|
      if rec["Account__c"] && rec["Account__c"] != ""
        account_id = rec["Account__c"]
        has_account = true
        break
      elsif rec["Lead__c"] && rec["Lead__c"] != ""
        lead_id = rec["Lead__c"]
        has_lead = true
        break
      end
    end
  end

  return nil unless has_account || has_lead

  if has_account
    { type: "Account", id: account_id, account: account_id, lead: nil }
  else
    { type: "Lead", id: lead_id, account: nil, lead: lead_id }
  end
end

# Convert ANY record (upsert/unchanged/skipped/orphan) to a flat lowercase shape
def to_flat(rec, customer_id, account_id_str, default_status)
  {
    "customer_id"                 => customer_id,
    "account_id"                  => account_id_str,
    "external_account_product_id" => rec["External_Account_Product_ID"] || "",
    "product"        => rec["Product"]        || "",
    "product_name"   => rec["Product_Name"]   || "",
    "unit"           => rec["Unit"]           || "",
    "bill_product"   => rec["Bill_Product"]   || "",
    "include_tiers"  => rec["Include_Tiers"] == true,
    "price"          => rec["Price"],
    "pricing_type"   => rec["Pricing_Type"]   || "",
    "tiers"          => rec["Tiers"]          || "",
    "record_status"  => rec["Record_Status"]  || default_status,
    "change_reason"  => rec["Change_Reason"]  || "",
    "sfdc_record_id" => rec["SFDC_Record_Id"] || ""
  }
end

# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================
sfdc_list = parse_sfdc_list(sfdc_data)
parent    = resolve_parent(account_id, lead_id, sfdc_list)

# ============================================================
# EARLY EXIT IF NO PARENT
# ============================================================
result = if parent.nil?
  {
    "error"                      => "No Account ID or Lead ID found — cannot upsert to SFDC",
    "upsert_list"                => [],
    "upsert_count"               => 0,
    "unchanged_list"             => [],
    "unchanged_count"            => 0,
    "skipped_inactive_new"       => [],
    "skipped_inactive_new_count" => 0,
    "orphan_list"                => [],
    "orphan_count"               => 0,
    "all_records"                => [],
    "all_records_count"          => 0,
    "account_id"                 => nil,
    "lead_id"                    => nil,
    "parent_type"                => nil
  }
else
  # ============================================================
  # INDEX EXISTING SFDC RECORDS
  # ============================================================
  sfdc_index = {}
  sfdc_list.each do |rec|
    ext_id = rec["External_Account_Product_ID__c"]
    next if ext_id.nil? || ext_id == ""
    sfdc_index[ext_id] = rec
  end

  # ============================================================
  # COMPARE & CLASSIFY
  # ============================================================
  upsert_list, unchanged_list = [], []
  skipped_inactive_new = []
  seen_keys = {}

  new_records.each do |rec|
    ext_id  = rec["External_Account_Product_ID"]
    current = sfdc_index[ext_id]
    seen_keys[ext_id] = true if current

    if current.nil?
      # NEW
      if rec["Bill_Product"] == "Inactive"
        rec["Record_Status"] = "Skipped"
        rec["Change_Reason"] = "New product but Inactive — not creating in SFDC"
        skipped_inactive_new << rec
      else
        rec["Record_Status"]  = "New"
        rec["Change_Reason"]  = parent[:type] == "Account" ? "New product — not in SFDC" : "New product on Lead"
        rec["SFDC_Record_Id"] = nil
        rec["Parent_Type"]    = parent[:type]
        rec["Parent_Id"]      = parent[:id]
        rec["Account_Id"]     = parent[:account]
        rec["Lead_Id"]        = parent[:lead]
        upsert_list << rec
      end

    else
      # EXISTING — COMPARE
      current_cost         = current["Cost__c"]
      current_status       = current["Status__c"]
      current_status       = "Active" if current_status.nil? || current_status == ""
      current_include      = normalize_bool(current["Include_Tiers__c"])
      current_pricing_type = normalize_text(current["Pricing_Type__c"])
      current_tiers        = normalize_text(current["Tiers__c"])

      new_include      = normalize_bool(rec["Include_Tiers"])
      new_pricing_type = normalize_text(rec["Pricing_Type"])
      new_tiers        = normalize_text(rec["Tiers"])

      cost_changed         = normalize_num(current_cost) != normalize_num(rec["Price"])
      status_changed       = current_status != rec["Bill_Product"]
      include_changed      = current_include != new_include
      pricing_type_changed = current_pricing_type != new_pricing_type
      tiers_changed        = current_tiers != new_tiers

      if cost_changed || status_changed || include_changed || pricing_type_changed || tiers_changed
        reasons = []
        reasons << "Cost: #{current_cost} → #{rec["Price"]}"                          if cost_changed
        reasons << "Status: #{current_status} → #{rec["Bill_Product"]}"               if status_changed
        reasons << "Include_Tiers: #{current_include} → #{new_include}"               if include_changed
        reasons << "Pricing_Type: #{current_pricing_type} → #{new_pricing_type}"      if pricing_type_changed
        reasons << "Tiers: updated"                                                   if tiers_changed

        rec["Record_Status"]  = "Changed"
        rec["Change_Reason"]  = reasons.join(" | ")
        rec["SFDC_Record_Id"] = current["Id"]
        rec["Parent_Type"]    = parent[:type]
        rec["Parent_Id"]      = parent[:id]
        rec["Account_Id"]     = parent[:account]
        rec["Lead_Id"]        = parent[:lead]
        upsert_list << rec
      else
        rec["Record_Status"] = "Unchanged"
        unchanged_list << rec
      end
    end
  end

  # ============================================================
  # ORPHAN DETECTION
  # ============================================================
  orphan_list = []
  sfdc_index.each do |ext_id, sfdc_rec|
    next if seen_keys[ext_id]
    next if sfdc_rec["Status__c"] == "Inactive"

    orphan_list << {
      "SFDC_Record_Id"              => sfdc_rec["Id"],
      "External_Account_Product_ID" => sfdc_rec["External_Account_Product_ID__c"],
      "Product"                     => sfdc_rec["Product__c"],
      "Price"                       => sfdc_rec["Cost__c"],
      "Bill_Product"                => "Inactive",
      "Record_Status"               => "Orphan",
      "Change_Reason"               => "No longer in pricing payload — mark inactive",
      "Parent_Type"                 => parent[:type],
      "Parent_Id"                   => parent[:id],
      "Account_Id"                  => parent[:account],
      "Lead_Id"                     => parent[:lead]
    }
  end

  # ============================================================
  # BUILD UNIFIED FLAT LIST (lowercase) for caller
  # ============================================================
  account_id_str = parent[:account] || parent[:lead] || ""

  all_records = []
  upsert_list.each          { |r| all_records << to_flat(r, customer_id, account_id_str, "Upserted") }
  unchanged_list.each       { |r| all_records << to_flat(r, customer_id, account_id_str, "Unchanged") }
  skipped_inactive_new.each { |r| all_records << to_flat(r, customer_id, account_id_str, "Skipped") }
  orphan_list.each          { |r| all_records << to_flat(r, customer_id, account_id_str, "Orphan") }

  # ============================================================
  # BUILD RESULT
  # ============================================================
  {
    # ---- Internal lists (used by SF upsert/orphan actions inside Fun-1.1) ----
    "upsert_list"                => upsert_list,
    "upsert_count"               => upsert_list.size,
    "unchanged_list"             => unchanged_list,
    "unchanged_count"            => unchanged_list.size,
    "skipped_inactive_new"       => skipped_inactive_new,
    "skipped_inactive_new_count" => skipped_inactive_new.size,
    "orphan_list"                => orphan_list,
    "orphan_count"               => orphan_list.size,

    # ---- Unified flat list (exposed to caller) ----
    "all_records"                => all_records,
    "all_records_count"          => all_records.size,

    # ---- Parent info ----
    "account_id"                 => parent[:account],
    "lead_id"                    => parent[:lead],
    "parent_type"                => parent[:type],
    "error"                      => nil
  }
end
